Accessed September 4, 2014. | website = {{nowrap|{{URL|https://townofharrison.com/}}}} | footnotes = }} '''Harrison''' is a [[Town (New Jersey)|town]] in the [[West Hudson, New Jersey|western part]] of [[Hudson County, New Jersey|Hudson County]] in the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Jersey]]. It is part of the [[New York metropolitan area]]. It is a suburb of the neighboring city of [[Newark, New Jersey|Newark]], and is located {{convert|8|mi}} from [[New York City]]. Once considered "the beehive of industry", the town is undergoing a residential and economic renewal, particularly along the [[Passaic River]].Brenzel, Kathryn. [http://www.nj.com/realestate-news/2015/05/ready_to_move_everything_you_n_4.html "Ready to move: How Harrison is transforming from an industrial powerhouse"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150514043153/http://www.nj.com/realestate-news/2015/05/ready_to_move_everything_you_n_4.html |date=May 14, 2015 }}, NJ Advance Media for [[NJ.com]], May 11, 2015. Accessed August 31, 2015. As of the [[2020 United States census]], the town's population was 19,450, an increase of 5,830 (+42.8%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 13,620, which in turn reflected a decrease of 804 (−5.6%) from the 14,424 counted in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7. Population for the Counties and Municipalities in New Jersey: 1990, 2000 and 2010], [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]], February 2011. Accessed May 1, 2023. The [[Population Estimates Program]] calculated a population of 22,182 for 2024.
